issues.reason: The passage is translated as one discourse and Core patterns lets the context pick the reading, so (On $x cliff_path) is the domain the immediately preceding sentence establishes; the resulting strength-0 rule is entailed by the sentence, while the unrestricted rule the reviewer wants would deny going-out of every lantern in the KB -- the over-assertion the calibration line actually bars.

"Where a THING is" restricts LocatedIn to containment prepositions ("in / at / inside / within") and an of-genitive routes to PartOf (part/component) or the opaque Possession, so (LocatedIn sk_lantern_1 sk_station_1) asserts a spatial containment no word states.

Names and casing makes the class atom mandatory for every minted referent ("an untyped referent symbol must never appear in the output"), and the parallel group atoms (lines 25-26) and the produce rule both type their object twice, so (Member (sk_mire_essence $x) mire_essence) is missing from the burn rule's conclusion.

Coordination & plurals requires a bare-plural episodic object taking part in the occurrence to mint a group witness, so "crowds of nightmoths" is a group whose members are crowds; collapsing it to one (Member sk_crowd_1 crowd) (and later binding the plural "the nightmoth crowds" to the single sk_crowd_2) drops the stated plurality of both mentions.

gaps_confirmed: approximate / hedged exact counts ("about thirty nightmoths"): Cardinality is specified to take a native integer and CardinalityPhrase only a number-less vague phrase, so a hedged count has no licensed carrier

an eventuality distributed over a counted subset of occasions ("on six of the next ten nights", "on those six nights"): Time admits structured calendar terms and deictic/named constants only -- a set-of-nights group witness fits no slot, and nothing distributes the event across the occasions
a forward multi-unit temporal window ("the next ten nights"): only the backward WithinLast window and the single-unit "next / following" increments are covered, so the "next" anchoring is unencodable

a per-period count rate ("about thirty nightmoths per night"): compound per-units are licensed only in the Measure family, so a count-per-period has to borrow (Every e 1 night), which says the counting recurred rather than that the count was per night
new_gaps: a plural of collections ("crowds of nightmoths", "the nightmoth crowds", "the hunts"): GroupOf takes a member KIND, so a group whose members are themselves groups has no exemplified form -- the outer group's "each of these is a crowd of nightmoths" can only be reached by an unexemplified per-member GroupOf rule

a day-of-year calendar ("on day 395 of Year 2"): the Time term (Day <n>) is the day-of-month slot, so a day numbered within the year can only be recorded by overloading it -- no licensed term distinguishes the two
defect_summary: "The lanterns of the three bright stations" must take the of-genitive route -- (PartOf sk_lantern_1 sk_station_1) if the lanterns are the stations' components, otherwise the opaque (Possession sk_lantern_1 sk_station_1) -- never LocatedIn; the per-member burn rule must add (Member (sk_mire_essence $x) mire_essence) beside its (Member (sk_mire_essence $x) extra); and "crowds of nightmoths" must mint an outer group (GroupOf sk_crowds_1 crowd) whose members are typed by a per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $c sk_crowds_1) (GroupOf $c nightmoth)), with "the nightmoth crowds" resolving to that group -- the nesting is licensed in principle but unexemplified, so it is filed as a gap.
notes: I agree with the reviewer's notes that (Time <e> sk_nights_2) and the light-verb reading of "the first cold snap came" are least-bad extensions rather than defects, and that the "about thirty" ParticleFromNormal count sits in the same gap territory. The "first cold snap OF YEAR 2" restriction is correctly carried on the entity as (Time sk_cold_snap_1 (Year 2)) rather than inside the Ordinal atom, matching the AmongMost precedent.
